newsitem.title: USA: MTS Systems wins $2-million order in Japan.
newsitem.headline: MTS Systems wins $2-million order in Japan.

text.p: MTS Systems Corp said Wednesday it received an order from an unidentified Japanese engine manufacturing company worth $2 million.

The order includes equipment capable of performing mechanical tests on metals, composites and advanced ceramic materials, MFS Systems said. The tests will be conducted on parts used to make advanced turbine engines for automotive, aerospace and power generation applications, the company said.
An MTS Systems spokesman declined to divulge the identity of the Japanese customer.
MTS Systems makes computer-based material testing systems.
